We confess that so often we try to clean up our lives first before we come to you
in the light a futile and useless task, or we confess that sometimes we make too little
of the darkness in our lives, as if it's not such a big deal.
And Lord, we confess that sometimes as Your children, we forget that Your light has already
dispelled our darkness, and we live as if we're back there.
Lord, in all of these ways, we confess and we ask that You would shed Your light into
our lives, that we would not be kept in darkness, that we would see ourselves as we are, and
that we would see You as You are, and that we would respond today and every day by joyfully
confidently responding to your invitation to come into the light and we
ask this in your name. Amen.
